planted.item: The board authorised management to negotiate the Harrowgate renewal with a liability cap of at least four hundred thousand dollars.
The board resolved to appoint Maria Ek as Chief Financial Officer with effect from the first of June twenty twenty six.
The board approved a budget of two point four million kronor for Project Lantern.
The board resolved not to propose an interim dividend and will revisit the issue at the September meeting.
Petra Voss will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.
Sofia Berg will prepare Maria Ek's service agreement for signature by the end of May.
Petra Voss said: “I will draft a short note to shareholders explaining the decision before the end of June.”
Whether the board will accept the fee increase for the Harrowgate renewal remains open.
The board discussed that the ownership of the data produced by Project Lantern has not been agreed upon and needs legal advice.
